scripts.dev:build: vite build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.dev: bun run dev:build && wrangler dev -c wrangler.jsonc -c engine/wrangler.jsonc --local-upstream localhost:8787
scripts.types: wrangler types -c wrangler.jsonc -c engine/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler types -c engine/wrangler.jsonc engine/worker-configuration.d.ts --env-interface EngineEnv --include-runtime=false
scripts.types:check: wrangler types --check -c wrangler.jsonc -c engine/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler types --check -c engine/wrangler.jsonc engine/worker-configuration.d.ts --env-interface EngineEnv --include-runtime=false
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:engine && bun run test:e2e
